#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
source /mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/column-env.sh
export TIDE_BUILD_DIR=/mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/columns-20261111/recurrent-dev2/build
export PYTHONPATH="$PWD/python:$PWD/tests:$PWD/scripts:$TIDE_BUILD_DIR"
python -m pip wheel --no-build-isolation --no-deps . -w /mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/columns-20261111/wheel-recurrent
python -m pip install --no-deps --target /mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/columns-20261111/install-recurrent /mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/columns-20261111/wheel-recurrent/*.whl
python -m pytest -q tests/test_native_recurrent_columns.py tests/test_kv_columns.py tests/test_column_positions.py tests/test_settle_columns.py tests/test_recurrent_columns.py tests/test_column_training.py tests/test_window_execution.py tests/test_block_attention.py tests/test_kv_block_query.py tests/test_weighted_columns.py tests/test_component_window.py tests/test_component_window_contracts.py tests/test_component_window_policy.py tests/test_independent_copies.py tests/test_collect_fc_suites.py --dtype both --junitxml=/mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/columns-20261111/recurrent-qualification.xml
python -m pytest -q tests/test_weighted_region_execution.py --dtype float64 --junitxml=/mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/columns-20261111/recurrent-general.xml
export PYTHONPATH=/mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/columns-20261111/install-recurrent
cd /tmp
for family in affine delta gated_delta ssd; do
 for client in python native; do
  for dtype in float64 float32; do
   python /mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/columns-20261111/qualified-recurrent/examples/consumer_core5/tensor_window.py --family "$family" --client "$client" --dtype "$dtype" --native-library "$TIDE_BUILD_DIR" --output-dir /mi/data2T/zlong/home/llm/graph-execution-foundation/artifacts/columns-20261111/recurrent-cpu-"$family"-"$client"-"$dtype"
  done
done
done
module purge
module load libtorch-npu/2.12.0-cann9.2.0
unset PYTHONPATH
